raw_segments.text: Instance he's playing now. Improvising might be what you like till you hear the words,
wanna listen sharp. Hard, begin all right, then hear chords a bit off, feel lost a bit.
In and out of sacks, over barrels, through wire fences, obstacle race. Time makes the
tune. Question of mood you're in, still always nice to hear. Except scales up and
down, girls learning. Two together next-door neighbors. Ought to invent dummy pianos for
that. Bloomin' lead I bought for her. The name.
Playing it slow, a girl, night I came home, the girl. Door of the stables near
Cecilia Street. Millie no taste. Queer because we both, I mean.
